title: Battle of Kings Mountain
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kings Mountain", at revision 1380216071, opens: "The Battle of Kings Mountain was fought on October 7, 1780, in South Carolina during the Southern theater of the American Revolutionary War. Fought almost entirely between Patriot and Loyalist troops, the battle resulted in a decisive Patriot victory. Taking place 9 miles (14 km) south of the present-day town of Kings Mountain, North Carolina in what is now rural Cherokee County, South Carolina, the battle has been described as "the war's largest all-American fight."" That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2035455, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1780 battle of the American Revolutionary War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
